correctness.rationale: The complete proof independently derives odd-index residues from the Lucas polynomial expansion, exact even-index 2-adic valuations from companion doubling, and odd-unit residue rigidity from the index-multiplication polynomial. This yields necessary and sufficient congruences via Legendre three-square theorem for all P even positive, B odd positive, n>=1. The two possible valuation parities yield explicit density sums and O(log N) counting error. The standalone checker corroborates 1,686,680 pairs by two distinct recurrence arithmetic methods, plus five dyadic-prefix tests. Finite checks are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Three-square representability of Lucas values is a motivated classical Diophantine question. The exact classification uniformly resolves the natural full even-trace/odd-companion two-parameter family singled out by the 2-adic hypothesis in Sobolewski, exposing distinct s=1 versus s>=2 lifting regimes, possible odd-index obstructions, five sharp rational densities, and logarithmic counting discrepancy. This is a complete structural classification rather than a single parameter substitution, arbitrary finite slice or numerical census. It refines published structural algorithms with a closed uniform answer.
